flag_warnings.max_model_len=180000: Chain mandate; experiments validated only 131072. First production load is the validation; long-context divergence risk if lower.
flag_warnings.max_num_seqs=128 (batch_size=64 hard cei: Phase 3 sweep observed batch_size=64 hangs the PoC engine (OOM-stuck, not crash — engine never recovers). max_num_seqs=128 from MINIMAX_M2_7 base is safe because vLLM runtime caps actual batch by KV cache; the hazard is operator-supplied PoC batch override. flag_descriptions.max_model_len=180000: Chain mandate; experiments validated only 131072. First production load is the validation; long-context divergence risk if lower.
flag_descriptions.moe_backend=triton: FlashInfer FP8 MoE paths (FLASHINFER_CUTLASS) underperform on Hopper sm_90 in vLLM 0.20 — auto-select picks them and silently regresses. TRITON forced explicitly so the 2368 nonces/min measurement is reproducible across vLLM versions.
flag_descriptions.attention_backend=FLASHINFER: vLLM auto-default on Hopper is FLASH_ATTN; FLASHINFER measured faster on the 2026-05 sweep. Pinning explicitly prevents the auto-selector heuristic from silently regressing this profile across vLLM releases.
flag_descriptions.tensor_parallel_size=4: 4×H100 = 320 GB HBM exactly matches chain VRam=320 GB requirement. Phase 3 batch sweep: 2→888, 8→2048, 16→2240, 32→2368 (best), 64→hang. shadecloud orion, 2026-05.
